description: Show how to call this API through its generated SDKs. With `slug` (from list_endpoints or search_docs): ready-to-use code for that endpoint in every SDK language, or in one with `language` (e.g. typescript, python, go). Without `slug`: the index of SDK methods, one line per endpoint.

language.description: Focus on one SDK language (e.g. typescript, python, go). Omit for all supported languages.

projectId.description: Project to read. Optional: defaults to the project this server was started with. Only pass it to target a different project.

slug.description: One endpoint by its slug. Omit for the index of methods.

name: get_sdk_methods
